title: Leïla & Samia — Le thé du samedi (format dialogue)
style: Modern stylized 3D animation, warm color palette, soft cinematic lighting, expressive characters, high quality render

characters.name: Leïla
characters.description: Leïla, a 34-year-old North African woman, sleek shoulder-length dark hair, sophisticated minimalist style with a cream blazer, intelligent weary eyes, elegant reserve

characters.name: Samia
characters.description: Samia, a 33-year-old North African woman, voluminous curly hair, colorful terracotta cardigan, big gold hoop earrings, warm mischievous smile, expressive energetic gestures

dialogue.speaker: samia
dialogue.text: Alors… le fameux Monsieur de l'appli ?

dialogue.speaker: leila
dialogue.text: Trois semaines de messages pour qu'il me demande si je fais du sport.

scenes.image_prompt: Two women having mint tea at a cozy Parisian cafe terrace, Samia leaning in curious with a teasing smile, Leïla stirring her tea with a flat unimpressed look, warm afternoon light
scenes.motion_prompt: Samia leans forward eagerly, Leïla slowly stirs her tea and raises a deadpan eyebrow, steam rises

dialogue.speaker: leila
dialogue.text: J'ai tout supprimé hier soir. Toutes les applis.

scenes.image_prompt: Samia bursting out laughing almost spilling her tea, Leïla calm and resolute showing her phone with an empty home screen, cafe terrace
scenes.motion_prompt: Samia laughs covering her mouth, Leïla slides her phone across the table showing the empty screen, small proud smile

dialogue.speaker: leila
dialogue.text: Non. J'arrête juste de chercher là où il n'y a rien.

scenes.image_prompt: Close on the two women, Samia suddenly serious with concern, Leïla looking away at the street with quiet dignity, soft light on her profile
scenes.motion_prompt: Samia tilts her head concerned, Leïla gazes at the street then back with a serene resolute look

dialogue.speaker: leila
dialogue.text: Pourquoi tu souris comme ça, toi ?

scenes.image_prompt: Samia with a mischievous knowing grin pulling out her phone, Leïla squinting at her with amused suspicion, cafe terrace golden light
scenes.motion_prompt: Samia grins and digs for her phone, Leïla crosses her arms with a suspicious smile

dialogue.speaker: samia
dialogue.text: Un dîner. Huit personnes, un vrai restaurant. Tous vérifiés, tous là pour du sérieux.

dialogue.speaker: leila
dialogue.text: Un dîner ? Genre… en vrai, avec des vrais gens ?

scenes.image_prompt: Samia showing her phone with a warm app interface displaying a dinner event card, Leïla leaning in skeptical but curious, their two faces lit by the warm screen
scenes.motion_prompt: Samia holds up the phone, Leïla leans in slowly, her skeptical face softening into curiosity

dialogue.speaker: samia
dialogue.text: En vrai. Tu parles, tu ris, tu vois. Pas de swipe.

scenes.image_prompt: Samia raising her tea glass as a toast with a triumphant smile, Leïla finally smiling a real smile and clinking her glass, warm complicity
scenes.motion_prompt: They clink tea glasses, Samia winks, Leïla laughs despite herself

dialogue.speaker: invite
dialogue.text: Et donc… le thé à la menthe, ou rien ?

scenes.image_prompt: Saturday evening restaurant dinner, Leïla laughing genuinely at a warm table, facing a sincere elegant 36-year-old North African man with a short beard and navy shirt who just made her laugh, candlelight, mint tea being poured
scenes.motion_prompt: The man pours mint tea theatrically, Leïla laughs a real open laugh, candles flicker, eye contact holds

scenes.vo: Les vraies conversations commencent autour d'une vraie table. Nour Meet. Inscris-toi gratuitement.
